<!-- *** BODY ************************************************************************************************************************** -->
<!-- *********************************************************************************************************************************** -->
## Description
This template monitors Logstash instances via the Logstash Monitoring API (HTTP). It collects node-level metrics including JVM performance, pipeline throughput, event processing, and overall health status.

## Requirements
- **Zabbix 7.0+** with HTTP agent support
- Logstash Monitoring API enabled and accessible from Zabbix server/proxy

## API security by Logstash version

| Logstash version | API security |
|------------------|-------------|
| 7.x (incl. 7.10.2) | No authentication available |
| 8.0 -- 8.6 | Limited / experimental only |
| 8.7+ | `api.auth.type: basic` supported |
| 8.8+ | Stable + TLS support |

## Installation

### 1. Enable the Logstash Monitoring API
Edit `/etc/logstash/logstash.yml` and configure the HTTP API:
```yaml
api.http.host: "0.0.0.0"
api.http.port: 9600
```

For Logstash **8.7+**, enable authentication (recommended):
```yaml
api.auth.type: basic
api.auth.basic.username: "zabbix"
api.auth.basic.password: "YourSecretPassword"
```

Restart Logstash after making changes:
```bash
sudo systemctl restart logstash
```

### 2. Import the Template
Download and import the [Logstash Template](./7.0/template_logstash_7.0.yaml) into your Zabbix server.

### 3. Link Template to Host
Assign the imported template to your Zabbix host representing the Logstash instance.

### 4. Configure Template Macros
Adjust template macros to match your environment:

| Macro | Description | Default |
|-------|-------------|---------|
| `{$LOGSTASH.PORT}` | Logstash Monitoring API port | `9600` |
| `{$LOGSTASH.HEAP.WARN}` | JVM heap usage warning threshold (%) | `80` |
| `{$LOGSTASH.HEAP.CRIT}` | JVM heap usage critical threshold (%) | `95` |
| `{$LOGSTASH.FD.WARN}` | File descriptor usage warning threshold (%) | `80` |

## Monitoring scope

### Node
- Logstash version, status (green/yellow/red), uptime
- Pipeline workers count, batch size
- Config reload successes and failures

### JVM
- Heap memory usage (used, max, percent)
- Non-heap memory usage
- Thread count (current, peak)
- Garbage collection (young/old generation count and time)

### Process
- CPU percent and load average (1m, 5m, 15m)
- Open / max file descriptors with usage percentage
- Virtual memory

### Events (global)
- Events in, out, filtered (rate)
- Event processing duration (rate)

### Pipeline discovery (LLD)
- Automatic discovery of all pipelines
- Per-pipeline: events in/out/filtered, duration, queue events, queue type
- Per-pipeline: reload successes and failures

## Triggers

| Trigger | Severity |
|---------|----------|
| Status is not green | High |
| JVM heap usage > warning threshold | Warning |
| JVM heap usage > critical threshold | High |
| File descriptors running low | Warning |
| Logstash restarted (uptime reset) | Info |
| Config reload failure | Warning |
| Pipeline reload failure (per pipeline) | Warning |
